[EN] Whose ass did you neglect kissing to get stationed here?
[ES] ¿A qué trasero olvidaste besar para que te asignaran aquí?

[EN] Are you here to talk or fight?
[ES] ¿Vienes a hablar o a pelear?

[EN] You're making quite a name for yourself, my friend.

Keep spilling the blood.
[ES] Te estás haciendo un gran nombre, amigo mío.

Sigue derramando sangre.

[EN] Still standing, eh?

Good. Means the argons aren't.
[ES] Sigues de pie, ¿eh?

Bien. Significa que los argons no.
